summary.name: AI Excel Bot
summary.one_liner: A web tool that generates Excel and Google Sheets formulas and VBA code from plain-English text prompts, and explains existing formulas.
use_cases: Writing Excel or Google Sheets formulas from a plain-English description
Generating or explaining VBA macros without writing them by hand
Looking up values with VLOOKUP or summing with SUMIF conditions
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool that turns simple text instructions into Excel or Google Sheets formulas, with an example converting a request into a SUMIF formula. It also explains formulas step by step, such as breaking down a VLOOKUP into its parts. It can write VBA code and explain it. A Chrome extension and an Excel add-in are offered on paid and free plans respectively, per the pricing section. It is described as using a GPT-3 model.
notable: Generates formulas from plain English prompts, with step-by-step formula explanations
Free tier includes a Chrome extension; Pro adds an Excel add-in and unlimited use
Built on GPT-3 according to the page meta description
caveats: Free plan is limited to 5 formula, code or task generations/explanations per month
Unlimited use and the Excel add-in require Pro at $2.99/month or $24.99/year
Page does not state which platforms the Excel add-in supports
